goals.statement: Create a bounded operational slice to repair the just command-runner runtime start/stop regressions discovered after merging the Make-to-just migration. Outcome: just stop works with installed just 1.51.0, start-all uses the readiness helper for subscription-external, billing, and cadence, and start-all includes cadence. Trigger: post-merge build/run proof failed on unsupported just -j, billing port conflict, and direct start recipes falsely reporting success.
